items.title: 2.1.1.2 Setting Up Python Development Environment (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Development environment
blocks.text: Development environment tayyar karne ka matlab computer ko Python code likhne, chalane aur debug karne ke liye tayyar karna hai: woh software, tools aur libraries install aur set karna jo development ko hamwar aur kaarkard banayein.

Python https://www.python.org/ se download aur install ki ja sakti hai. Install karte waqt 'Add Python to PATH' wala dabba tick karein ta ke Python command line se aasani se chal sake. Acha Integrated Development Environment (IDE) coding aasan banata hai, aur Python programs likhne aur chalane ke liye online services bhi istemal ho sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Python ko command line se aasani se chalane ke liye install karte waqt kya karna chahiye (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: 'Add Python to PATH' tick karein, option (c).

items: Tayyari: python.org se Python install karein, 'Add Python to PATH' tick karein, IDE ya online service chunein.
